purpose: Untouched non-Western geographic evaluation for reviewer-requested revised methods; model comparison is frozen separately after development-only work.

dataset.name: US EPA AQS Houston-Harris County hourly sensor network
dataset.license_or_terms: US EPA public monitoring data; preserve source attribution and retrieval metadata
dataset.time_zone: America/Chicago civil clock audited against AQS local fields; fixed UTC-06:00 local standard time used for the canonical calendar
dataset.station_selection_rule: Require PM2.5, then sort by relevant pollutant count, complete PM2.5-NO2-O3 core, PM2.5-plus-O3 availability, mean minimum annual coverage, and site ID; all descending except site ID.
dataset.target_policy: Score every prespecified station-pollutant cell with an observed target; also report pollutant and availability strata.

split_policy.test: 2025-01-01 through 2025-12-31; not downloaded until final freeze
split_policy.test_access_rule: Do not download or parse Houston 2025 until revised models, calibration, outage scenarios, checkpoints, inference, statistics, and reporting code are frozen from development data.

next_gate: Prepare and audit 2021-2024 only; implement and freeze the revised comparison before any Houston 2025 download.
